test_title: SSC GD Constable 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the concerned Union Ministry that introduced the Jammu and Kashmir Local Bodies Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024 in the parliament?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** (MHA) is responsible for maintaining internal security and domestic policy within India.
 
• The **Jammu and Kashmir Local Bodies Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024** was introduced to make amendments in the functioning and administration of local bodies in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The bill aims to enhance the **efficiency, transparency, and democratic functioning** of local government bodies in the region.
 
• The introduction of this bill is in line with the **Government of India's efforts** to strengthen governance and local self-rule in Jammu and Kashmir after its reorganization into a Union Territory under the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019**.
 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs oversees **law and order, governance, and administration** in Union Territories, making it the concerned ministry for this bill.
 
• The bill also reflects the government's commitment to promoting **grassroots democracy** and ensuring equitable development in Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare**__

 __
 
• This ministry is responsible for policies and programs related to **agriculture, farmer welfare, and allied activities**.
 
• It oversees schemes such as **PM-KISAN, Soil Health Card, and Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana**.
 
• However, it has no direct role in matters of governance or local bodies in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of AYUSH**__
 __
 
• The Ministry of AYUSH focuses on the development of **traditional systems of medicine** such as Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy.
 
• It promotes **holistic healthcare** but does not deal with legislative matters related to local governance.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Defence**__
 
 
• The Ministry of Defence is responsible for matters related to **national security, armed forces, and defense policy**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the security of Jammu and Kashmir but does not oversee local governance or administration.
